contactInfo.headline: Crafting digital experiences that push boundaries.
contactInfo.subheadline: Service & Product based IT company building high-performance web applications, mobile platforms, custom desktop software, and intelligent automation systems.
contactInfo.tagline: Building the Future, One Pixel at a Time.

services.title: Web Development
services.fullDesc: At NetCraft Studio, we create powerful, responsive web applications that drive business growth. Our expertise spans modern frontend frameworks and robust backend systems, delivering solutions that are fast, secure, and engineered to scale seamlessly.
services.shortDesc: Custom websites and scalable web applications built with modern frontend and backend technologies.
deliverables: React & Next.js Single Page & Server-Rendered Applications
Core Web Vitals & Search Engine Performance Optimization

services.title: App Development
services.fullDesc: We develop high-performance mobile applications that deliver exceptional user experiences. Whether you need a native app for maximum speed or a cross-platform React Native solution, our team brings your product vision into app stores smoothly.
services.shortDesc: Native and cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android delivering fluid, native performance.

services.title: UI/UX Design
services.fullDesc: Our UI/UX design services create visually stunning and user-friendly interfaces that drive engagement. We combine user research, wireframing, interactive prototyping, and design systems tailored to elevate your brand presence.
services.shortDesc: Beautiful, intuitive designs that convert visitors into loyal customers through human-centered craft.
deliverables: Design Systems, Component Libraries & Design Tokens

services.title: Website Restructuring
services.fullDesc: Transform outdated websites into modern, high-performance digital assets. We audit, redesign, and rebuild existing sites to meet current security and speed standards while preserving SEO authority and brand identity.
services.shortDesc: Modernize and optimize your existing website with improved architecture, 3x speed, and zero downtime.
deliverables: Monolith to Modern Component Architecture Migration
Core Web Vitals Tuning & SEO Recovery

services.title: Product Development
services.fullDesc: Turn your vision into a market-ready digital product. We handle everything from MVP development to scaling, ensuring your product succeeds in competitive markets with resilient technical architecture and clear roadmaps.
services.shortDesc: End-to-end digital product development from concept and MVP validation through market scale.

services.title: Automation Solutions
services.fullDesc: Reduce repetitive work and boost organizational efficiency. Our custom automation tools connect disparate software, automate business workflows, and let your team focus on high-impact strategic tasks.
services.shortDesc: Streamline business operations with intelligent automation systems that eliminate manual workload.

services.title: Internet of Things (IoT)
services.fullDesc: Bridge hardware with cloud intelligence. We build IoT architectures that collect live telemetric data from connected devices, process streams in real-time, and present actionable insights on responsive dashboards.
services.shortDesc: Connect smart devices and sensors for real-time monitoring, telemetry, and intelligent decision-making.

services.title: Desktop Applications
services.fullDesc: Engineered with modern frameworks like Electron JS for high performance, local hardware and printer integration, offline reliability, and seamless experiences across all major desktop operating systems.
services.shortDesc: Powerful cross-platform desktop applications for Windows, macOS, and Linux with offline capability.
deliverables: Cross-Platform Windows, macOS & Linux Desktop Apps
Native File System & OS Window Control

projects.title: Event Registration & Ticketing Suite
projects.description: Full-featured event registration and ticket management platform handling seat allocation, QR ticketing, and automated check-in.
projects.longDescription: A complete event management platform handling registration, QR ticket generation, seat reservation, email confirmations, and fast mobile check-in verification for corporate conferences and public gatherings.

projects.title: Retail Billing & Invoicing POS
projects.description: Automated billing and invoicing desktop application with customer ledgers, tax calculation, and PDF export.
projects.longDescription: A powerful desktop application for retail billing and automated invoice generation featuring tax calculations, customer accounts ledger, barcode scanning compatibility, and instant PDF invoice printing.

projects.title: Adhivelan Masala Digital Showcase
projects.description: Modern digital product catalog, brand showcase, and distributor inquiry system for a regional spices manufacturer.
projects.longDescription: Engineered a vibrant digital identity and product catalog for Adhivelan Masala, showcasing authentic spice products, nutritional facts, distribution channels, and regional dealer inquiry portals.

projects.title: Uzhavar Connect
projects.description: Agricultural marketplace connecting farmers directly to consumers, enabling direct sales of fresh produce with supply chain logistics.
projects.longDescription: A digital marketplace platform that bridges the gap between farmers and consumers, enabling direct sales of fresh produce. Includes supply chain tracking, quality assurance, GPS logistics management, and direct farmer-to-consumer payments.

projects.title: Amirdha Stickers
projects.description: Creative custom sticker and design e-commerce store featuring a real-time interactive design studio and instant preview.
projects.longDescription: A specialized e-commerce store for custom stickers and designs with real-time design customization, live preview, bulk order processing, and fast turnaround manufacturing integration.

projects.title: Sri Sastha Travels
projects.description: Comprehensive travel booking and itinerary management system for tourism packages, hotel reservations, and custom journeys.
projects.longDescription: A comprehensive travel booking platform offering tour packages, hotel reservations, flight bookings, and itinerary customization. Features multi-language support, real-time pricing, and interactive journey maps.

projects.title: Employee Attendance & Payroll System
projects.description: Modern attendance management system streamlining check-in/out processes with facial recognition, real-time analytics, and payroll integration.
projects.longDescription: A modern attendance management system that streamlines employee check-in and check-out processes with real-time reporting, biometric facial recognition, leave management, and automated integration with enterprise payroll systems.

projects.title: Student QR Attendance System
projects.description: Innovative QR code-based attendance solution for educational institutions with real-time class summaries and parent alerts.
projects.longDescription: An innovative QR code-based attendance platform for schools and universities that simplifies attendance marking. Students scan unique QR codes to mark attendance instantly, while teachers and administrators access real-time reports and parent notification feeds.

projects.title: Accounting & Financial Ledger System
projects.description: Complete desktop accounting software for managing ledgers, balance sheets, expense tracking, and regulatory compliance.
projects.longDescription: A comprehensive accounting software suite for managing double-entry ledgers, financial statements, expense auditing, budget forecasting, and compliance reporting with multi-company support and interactive analytics.

projects.title: Fine Management System
projects.description: Traffic violation penalty and fine management system with digital payment gateway integration and automated notifications.
projects.longDescription: A comprehensive municipal fine management platform enabling traffic authorities to track violations, compute penalties, record evidence, and process digital citizen payments with automated SMS notifications.

projects.title: Campus Navigation Map
projects.description: Interactive campus mapping and wayfinding system with real-time facility locator, event updates, and route planning.
projects.longDescription: An interactive spatial mapping system for university campuses providing real-time indoor and outdoor wayfinding, building locators, campus event announcements, and a searchable student facilities directory.
